metadata.title: Geometrically formal Hermitian metrics on compact complex surfaces
metadata.abstract: We classify compact complex surfaces admitting either a geometrically Dolbeault formal or an ABC-geometrically formal Hermitian metric. Furthermore, we prove that on a compact Kähler surface, every ABC-geometrically formal metric is Kähler, whereas, for geometrically Dolbeault formal Hermitian metrics, Gauduchon, LCK, and Kähler conditions are equivalent. On non-Kähler surfaces, an ABC-geometrically formal Hermitian metric is LCK and, except on Inoue surfaces, Vaisman.
